svg.title: Book Tracker pages, navigation, and page-local actions
svg.desc: Signed-in readers use the primary navigation for their library and settings. Linked books open authenticated shared-work pages with opted-in reader summaries. My site controls book-sharing consent. The restricted admin overview links to catalog curation. Dotted links open write dialogs or page-local actions rather than new routes.
